summary: Frontend-only regression test for toFixed white-screen crash fix on Memories homepage. Loaded preview URL at 1920x800, waited 15+ seconds (past the previous 2-3s crash window), scrolled to reviews/footer, opened chat widget, and monitored console + pageerror events. The fix is verified: NO 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toFixed)' error occurs, and the hero/stats remain rendered continuously even though /api/products and /api/reviews return HTTP 500 (known preview-only backend Atlas auth issue).

minor.issue: All return HTTP 500 in preview (MongoDB Atlas auth failing). Out of scope per review request, but the frontend now handles it gracefully.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix pattern Number(value ?? 0).toFixed(n) is correct and defensive; consider extracting a small utility helper (e.g., formatNumber(v, digits)) to avoid repeating the pattern across ReviewSystemEnhanced.js, DigitalWallet.js, and AdvancedPhotoCustomizer.js.
Backend Atlas auth failure causes many 500s on public endpoints; not the bug under test but should be tracked separately by main agent since it degrades UX (empty products grid, no reviews).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview backend MongoDB Atlas creds are failing => /api/products, /api/reviews, /api/reviews/stats return 500. Frontend handles this gracefully after the toFixed fix. If retesting other flows that need product/review data, expect empty states and address backend infra first.
rca of the issue: Original bug: numeric fields from API (reviewStats.average_rating, googleData.rating, wallet balances, photoTransform.scale) were rendered via value.toFixed(n) directly. When the API returned undefined/null/500 and state contained undefined for those fields, .toFixed threw TypeError, crashing React and blanking the page. Fix (verified): wrap with Number(value ?? 0).toFixed(n) and merge partial API responses onto default state objects in ReviewSystemEnhanced setReviewStats. Verified no toFixed error over a 15+ second observation window even with 500 responses from backend.
